name: Galleria at Sunset
summary: Southwestern-themed mall with 125+ eateries, shops & department stores.
demographics: The Galleria at Sunset primarily serves Henderson and southeast Las Vegas Valley residents, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000 annually. The trade area demographics skew toward suburban families with children, empty nesters, and young professionals aged 25-54 who value convenience and variety in their shopping experiences. The center draws from Henderson's rapidly growing population, which is notably more family-oriented and affluent than the broader Las Vegas metro area, with visitors seeking both everyday necessities and leisure shopping in a comfortable, climate-controlled environment.
description: Galleria at Sunset is Henderson, Nevada's premier enclosed shopping destination, conveniently located at 1300 West Sunset Road in the heart of this thriving Las Vegas suburb. This vibrant regional mall serves as a community gathering place, offering an extensive selection of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment experiences under one roof. The center features a diverse tenant mix spanning fashion, home goods, specialty retail, and a comprehensive food court, making it a one-stop destination for locals and visitors alike. With its family-friendly atmosphere, the mall regularly hosts seasonal events including holiday performances, Santa photo opportunities, and exclusive shopping promotions throughout the year. The Galleria at Sunset combines the convenience of traditional mall shopping with modern amenities, creating a welcoming environment for shoppers of all ages in the rapidly growing Henderson market.
